title: Padmé Amidala
subtitle: Galactic Republic
franchise: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith
description: As the hopeful, courageous leader of Naboo, Padmé Amidala transitioned from royal Queen to Senator for her people. As a Senator in the days before the Clone Wars began, she fell in love with the charismatic Jedi Anakin Skywalker and secretly married him. Quietly, she worked to end the war, but Chancellor Palpatine was always one step ahead of her, even when it came to her husband.
